name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: `[S` / `]S` jump to the first task of the previous / next occupied review group, cycling. Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews. Ctrl+Shift+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `b`: it opens the Task Card's Depends on stage for the task, a Task Link's linked task, or a counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+B>` batch; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B is Ctrl+Shift+P then `⇧B`: it opens the Blocks stage for a task or Task Link, supports counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B>`, and works from Depends-On and BLOCKS lines, where Ctrl+Shift+P on a BLOCKS line also opens the owner’s stage directly. On an inbox task every non-closing Task Card answer, the Ctrl+Shift+Enter toggle, and Alt+N ask where the task goes before writing and move there. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a stamped `*YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM*` entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F ask due WIP and Next tasks why they stay on their rung, and ask due Ready keeps why they stay; every counted keep on every rung writes one rung-qualified Rotten Log entry in one undo (blank logs no reason given), while early and Today-linked lane keeps stamp quietly with no prompt and no entry. Freshness gestures never ask for or write a Work Log summary. Counted N<Alt+F> and Task Link sessions show one Keep reason prompt; one Enter submits it. Each counted keep gets its own rung-qualified entry; Ready at-limit targets still skip unstamped and unlogged. The decay card shows the logged keeps in its header; Enter steps one rung (WIP → Next → Ready → priority, with the bottom level rolling in place), while Alt+F opens Stay and records its reason in Rotten Log. Step and Drop also log their rung event in the same undo as the task change; Ready alone offers Less often and explicit levels. On a landed RECURRING row both write nothing, show the recurring-tier notice, and stay. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3). Stage-ending completions append `· STAGE ✓`. `]s` / `[s` away from the current review task first return to it. The Task Card level strip and priority notices render the shared signal-bar priority mark through the bob-ledger-tools api.priorityMarks v1 namespace, falling back to the Lucide signal icons without it. The Task Card header's BLOCKED lane chip renders the shared blocked-reason miniature with its After / Until / Via reason list through the bob-ledger-tools api.blockMarks v1 namespace, and the P1-P4 strip shows a hollow teaching digit beside each level's bars, both falling back to today's look without it. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress — asking once for an optional Work Log summary when moving back to Next — through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace. Closing a planned task opens one grouped successor picker when offers exist; nothing starts selected, and the cycler applies only chosen links. Successor picker v2 and notice v2 also present a leaf project's keep-moving offers: a ⏭ Keep ‹project› moving group with a why caption, a "not dependents" tag, lane names instead of status symbols, and one blocked / scheduled later / hidden fold line, rendered last in a mixed picker. Successor picker v3 and notice v3 present relation offers as a 🪢 group titled ‹Label› “‹T›”, with a why caption, a "your links · not dependents" tag, a fold line, lane names, and the link-2 header icon when every group is relational. The pulled-in summary is shown through nav api.notice v3. Review-row closes append the cycler's additive `successorNotice` line to the walk toast. Journals each counted ]s answer, with its outcome, through the bob-ledger-tools api.stats namespace. Depends-On writes now mirror open dependents into generated 🧱 BLOCKS lines, in the same-note transaction or a checked cross-note follow-up, including counted, marked, Ctrl+D, hand-edit (and undo), conversion, and Ctrl+Shift+M paths. Adding an open prerequisite from Ctrl+Shift+P consumes the newly Blocked task's live links from today's open Pomodoros by resolved task identity; link-only bullets with child notes become the task's clean display text and keep those notes. It removes only entries this gesture emptied, leaves childless placeholders alone, and preserves closed timed rows. Cmd+Enter on a reading task, Task Link, or managed embed opens its source_pdf in Highlights without vault writes, while other targets retain Obsidian’s new-tab behavior. Turns on Templater's device-local "Trigger on file creation" when it is unset, so Cmd+N and other new notes get the vault's folder template (_templates/new_note.md). Only the BLOCKS chips in bob-ledger-tools use nav `api.blocks` v1, for ＋ and hover ×. The nav api gains an additive `openReferencePdf(path)` member (Promise of `{ok, reason?}`; the api `version` is unchanged) so the bob-ledger-tools Reading Board can hand a reference PDF to Highlights without vault writes. `Z` (mapped in the vault vimrc) or the "Zoom image on cursor line" command opens the image on the cursor line — an embed, image link, or Markdown image — in a full-window viewer with keyboard and mouse zoom and pan, importing a bullet holding only an image path through bob first; `y` copies its recorded original path (or the vault path / URL), and `r` restores only the picked link to a present recorded original path in one undoable edit. Native image clicks are unchanged. Task relations use 🪢 LINKS and generated LINKED FROM rows; nav api.relations v1 opens either stage and removes live links. The Task Card offers Links to (l) and Linked from (⇧L), with Ctrl+Shift+L and Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L commands; on a Task Link they open the linked task's stage in its own note, and on a Depends-On line they open the owner's. CURRENT shows existing links or sources, Enter applies or removes, Ctrl+Enter edits a relation label, `~` in the filter flips direction, and Ctrl+D clears all outgoing Links to relations while refusing generated Linked from rows. Counted Ctrl+Shift+L applies one target to every selected source; reverse counted links are refused. Alt+P applies the Task Card recommendation in one key, sets P1 on a task with no priority, stays hidden for immediate rolls and decays, and waits on the visible card before cancellation. `]s` landings end their toast with the `Alt+P` roll preview from nav `api.quickRoll` v1. Pomodoro move and rename pickers offer recent task types with component swatches and near-duplicate hints; rename previews count linked task type changes; Ctrl+D hides or restores Recent suggestions only. `]w` / `[w` (mapped in the vault vimrc) walk Pending, Next, and Ready tasks off today's plan — the dash PENDING/NEXT/READY sections — with a lane-colored toast and walk rail; `]W` / `[W` jump to the first task of the next / previous lane, cycling. [n` / `]n` (mapped in the vault vimrc) open the note's previous / next labeled link; `]]` / `[[` repeat the last bracket walk — `]s` review, `]w` lanes, or `]n` links — forward / backward, remembered per device. Ctrl+Shift+- changes the current note's parent: a panel pre-filled with the current parent ranks existing notes, previews the new ancestry, refuses cycles, and rewrites only the `parent:` frontmatter line as a quoted wikilink in one undo. The status bar always shows the bracket-repeat mode as `[[ s w n ]]` with the active walk lit; click a letter to switch. Ctrl+S splits the selected open merged Pomodoro by type: two types split the right one at once, three or more open a picker with an All row and Tab-marked type rows, and the Bob: Split Pomodoro by type palette command does the same with no default hotkey. Ctrl+Shift+T splits the bullet under the cursor into its own task (counted `N<Ctrl+Shift+T>` takes that bullet plus the next N siblings, and a visual selection splits every touched head line), leaving a live link stub and landing the cursor on the first new task in one undo. A merge label in Ctrl+Shift+L, counted Ctrl+Shift+L, and Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L previews and commits through `bob task merge` via the Bob Ledger Tools api.taskMerge namespace, with the consequence strip, an offer pick, an Undo merge notice, and a mobile refusal. `api.quickRoll` previews carry additive `parts`.
